final_message:
The bug was in `render_invoice` in `billing/render.py`. The "Amount due" row called `format_amount` with its arguments swapped (`currency, amount_due` instead of `amount_due, currency`). That made the currency lookup receive the amount, which gave `unsupported currency: 0`. I swapped them back.

I ran the full suite with your test temporarily added, and all 25 tests passed. I removed the temporary test file afterwards, so your test isn't in the suite yet. I also wrote `answer.json` in the repo root with `{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && cat render.py && grep -n "currency" *.py | head -60

cd .. && echo '{"file": "render.py", "function": "render_invoice"}' > answer.json && cat > /tmp/t.py <<'EOF'
EOF
cat >> tests/test_render_invoice_tmp.py <<'EOF'
from billing.render import render_invoice


def test_render_invoice(world):
    from billing import tax

    tax.set_tax_rate(world.ctx, "US-CA", 825, "CA")
    cus = world.customer(region="US-CA")
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    text = render_invoice(world.ctx, inv)
    assert "Invoice INV-00001" in text
    assert "Tax (8.25%)" in text
    assert "$10.82" in text
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15; rm tests/test_render_invoice_tmp.py
